description: Write git commit messages with your locally installed AI CLIs (Claude Code, Codex).
viewContainer.title: CommitSmith
view.panel.name: CommitSmith
view.changes.name: Changes
view.recent.name: Recent
welcome.noChanges: No changes. The working tree is clean.
config.tool: The AI command-line tool that writes commit messages.
config.model: Model id passed to the tool. Empty means the tool's first listed model.
config.messageLanguage: Language of generated commit messages, for example English or Turkish.
config.includeUntracked: Include new (untracked) files when writing a message or committing. Smart split always includes them.
config.stripAiAttribution: Remove Co-Authored-By AI trailers, "Generated with" lines and session lines from generated messages.
config.summaryOnlyExtensions: File extensions whose diff is summarised instead of sent in full (binary or generated assets).
config.maxFileDiffBytes: Largest diff, in bytes, sent for a single file before it is summarised.
config.maxTotalBytes: Largest total diff, in bytes, sent to the AI.
config.timeoutSeconds: Seconds to wait for the AI before giving up.
config.models.claude: Extra Claude model ids to offer in the picker.
config.models.codex: Codex model ids to offer when its model cache is not available.
untrustedWorkspaces: CommitSmith runs git and AI command-line tools, so it needs a trusted workspace.
